future_bounded_retry: Human must set explicit attempt/time/service caps before activation; transient timeout/429/5xx may be candidates, no unbounded retry. No retry in this window.

error_classes.401_403_terms_or_permission: STOP; do not bypass or switch provider
error_classes.3xx: Record Location; no automatic redirect to another endpoint
error_classes.404_410: Endpoint identity/service issue, not proof whole provider failed
error_classes.timeout_429_5xx: Transient candidate only under approved retry policy
error_classes.200_nonCSV_schema_unit_date_drift: QC fail closed, retain bytes/reasons, no model input

endpoint_vs_provider: One failed URL is endpoint evidence only; provider outage needs independent authorized evidence, not unapproved probe requests.
fallback_gate: Only exact licensed/authorized whitelist routes; match schema, units, security/session/segment/adjustment semantics, temporal eligibility; otherwise keep isolated source identity and reject use.
temporal_gate: Actual observation/session and receipt/QC before approved freeze; unknown publication remains UNKNOWN, not receipt-imputed. Calendar/freshness must be qualified; no after-open info or rewriting old prediction.
qc_provenance: Keep exact source/dataset/license/request/retrieval/raw/manifest hashes, QC and exclusions; missing is not zero; no silent unit conversion.
recovery: Preserve missing-session gaps; only separately authorized bounded backfill, retain actual later receipt/BACKFILL or RECOVERY identity, never original timely forward capture.
unresolved: Service rate/retry caps and operation authorization
Fallback source/route licenses and semantic compatibility; none authorized here
